exempt_professions_list.quote: This chapter does not apply to: (1) a student enrolled in an approved academic program in dietetics...(2) a dietitian who is serving in the Armed Forces or who is employed by any other federal agency...(3)(a) a person in a licensed healthcare profession providing diet, food, or nutrition information within the scope of his or her practice...(4) a person who performs the activities and services of a nutrition educator in the employment of a federal, state, county, or municipal agency...(5) an employee of a state agency who is engaging in the practice of dietetics...(7) a person marketing or distributing food, food materials, or food supplements...(8) a person providing weight control services...(9) any faith-based promotional health programs
